verses.original: מִרְיָ֤ם וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וַתְּדַבֵּ֨ר בְּמֹשֶׁ֔ה עַל־ אֹד֛וֹת הַכֻּשִׁ֖ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָאִשָּׁ֥ה לָקָ֑ח כִּֽי־ לָקָֽח׃ כֻשִׁ֖ית אִשָּׁ֥ה
verses.transliteration: mir·yām wə·’a·hă·rōn wat·tə·ḏab·bêr bə·mō·šeh ‘al- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ hak·ku·šîṯ ’ă·šer hā·’iš·šāh lā·qāḥ kî- lā·qāḥ ḵu·šîṯ ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of . . . the Cushite - woman he had married for he had taken a Cushite wife

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֣ר הֲרַ֤ק אַךְ־ בְּמֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ הֲלֹ֖א גַּם־ דִבֵּ֑ר בָּ֣נוּ יְהוָֽה׃ וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh dib·ber hă·raq ’aḵ- bə·mō·šeh way·yō·mə·rū hă·lō gam- ḏib·bêr bā·nū Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘
verses.literal: Does the LORD speak only . . . through Moses they said Does He not also speak through us And the LORD heard this

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד עָנָו וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מִכֹּל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh mə·’ōḏ ʿå̄·nå̄w wə·hā·’îš mik·kōl hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Now Moses was a very humble man more so than any man - on the face of the earth

verses.original: פִּתְאֹ֗ם יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ מִרְיָ֔ם שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶ֖ם צְא֥וּ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד שְׁלָשְׁתָּֽם׃ וַיֵּצְא֖וּ
verses.transliteration: piṯ·’ōm Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- mir·yām šə·lā·šə·tə·ḵem ṣə·’ū ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ šə·lā·šə·tām way·yê·ṣə·’ū
verses.literal: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses Aaron . . . and Miriam You three come out to the Tent of Meeting So the three went out

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וַיִּקְרָא֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמִרְיָ֔ם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃ וַיֵּצְא֖וּ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yê·reḏ bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel way·yiq·rā ’a·hă·rōn ū·mir·yām šə·nê·hem way·yê·ṣə·’ū
verses.literal: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud stood at the entrance to the Tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam When both of them had stepped forward

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑י אִם־ יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֗ה אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע אֵלָ֣יו בַּמַּרְאָה֙ אֲדַבֶּר־ בּֽוֹ׃ בַּחֲל֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·‘ū- nā ḏə·ḇā·rāy ’im- yih·yeh nə·ḇî·’ă·ḵem Yah·weh ’eṯ·wad·dā‘ ’ê·lāw bam·mar·’āh ’ă·ḏab·ber- bōw ba·ḥă·lō·wm
verses.literal: He said Hear now My words If there is a prophet [among you] [I], the LORD will reveal Myself to him in a vision I will speak to him in a dream

verses.original: לֹא־ כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֽוּא׃ נֶאֱמָ֥ן בְּכָל־ בֵּיתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵên ‘aḇ·dî mō·šeh hū ne·’ĕ·mān bə·ḵāl bê·ṯî
verses.literal: [But this is] not so with My servant Moses he is faithful in all My house

verses.original: אֲדַבֶּר־ בּ֗וֹ פֶּ֣ה אֶל־ פֶּ֞ה וּמַרְאֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א בְחִידֹ֔ת יַבִּ֑יט וּתְמֻנַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה וּמַדּ֙וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּ֖ר בְּעַבְדִּ֥י בְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏab·ber- bōw peh ’el- peh ū·mar·’eh wə·lō ḇə·ḥî·ḏōṯ yab·bîṭ ū·ṯə·mu·naṯ Yah·weh ū·mad·dū·a‘ lō yə·rê·ṯem lə·ḏab·bêr bə·‘aḇ·dî ḇə·mō·šeh
verses.literal: I speak with him face to face clearly and not in riddles he sees the form of the LORD Why then vvv were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses
So the anger of the LORD burned against them and He departed

verses.original: וְהֶעָנָ֗ן סָ֚ר מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִרְיָ֖ם מְצֹרַ֣עַת כַּשָּׁ֑לֶג אַהֲרֹ֛ן וַיִּ֧פֶן אֶל־ מִרְיָ֖ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְצֹרָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·nān sār mê·‘al hā·’ō·hel wə·hin·nêh mir·yām mə·ṣō·ra·‘aṯ kaš·šā·leḡ ’a·hă·rōn way·yi·p̄en ’el- mir·yām wə·hin·nêh mə·ṣō·rā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent suddenly Miriam [became] leprous [white] as snow Aaron turned toward her saw that she [was] leprous

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י נָ֨א אַל־ תָשֵׁ֤ת עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹאַ֖לְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’a·hă·rōn ’el- mō·šeh bî ’ă·ḏō·nî nā ’al- ṯā·šêṯ ‘ā·lê·nū ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer nō·w·’al·nū wa·’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: and said . . . to Moses . . . My lord please do not hold against us this sin - we have so foolishly - committed

verses.original: נָ֥א אַל־ תְהִ֖י כַּמֵּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְשָׂרֽוֹ׃ חֲצִ֥י וַיֵּאָכֵ֖ל בְּצֵאתוֹ֙ אִמּ֔וֹ מֵרֶ֣חֶם
verses.transliteration: nā ’al- ṯə·hî kam·mêṯ ’ă·šer ḇə·śā·rōw ḥă·ṣî way·yê·’ā·ḵêl bə·ṣê·ṯōw ’im·mōw mê·re·ḥem
verses.literal: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֕ל נָ֛א רְפָ֥א נָ֖א לָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yiṣ·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr ’êl nā rə·p̄ā nā lāh
verses.literal: So Moses cried out to the LORD . . . O God please heal - her

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְאָבִ֙יהָ֙ יָרֹ֤ק יָרַק֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יהָ הֲלֹ֥א תִכָּלֵ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים תִּסָּגֵ֞ר מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mō·šeh wə·’ā·ḇî·hā yā·rōq yā·raq bə·p̄ā·ne·hā hă·lō ṯik·kā·lêm šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tis·sā·ḡêr mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·’a·ḥar tê·’ā·sêp̄
verses.literal: But the LORD . . . answered Moses If her father had but spit . . . in her face would she not have been in disgrace for seven days Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days after that she may be brought back in

verses.original: מִרְיָ֛ם וַתִּסָּגֵ֥ר מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְהָעָם֙ לֹ֣א נָסַ֔ע עַד־ מִרְיָֽם׃ הֵאָסֵ֖ף
verses.transliteration: mir·yām wat·tis·sā·ḡêr mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·hā·‘ām lō nā·sa‘ ‘aḏ- mir·yām hê·’ā·sêp̄
verses.literal: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days and the people did not move on until [she] was brought in again

verses.original: וְאַחַ֛ר הָעָ֖ם נָסְע֥וּ מֵחֲצֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar hā·‘ām nā·sə·‘ū mê·ḥă·ṣê·rō·wṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·miḏ·bar pā·rān
verses.literal: After that the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran
